en: A black-and-white illustrated postcard depicting a panoramic, bird's-eye view of a coastal city with a bay labeled 'Golfo di Salonico'. Several ships are visible in the harbor. The surrounding terrain, mountains, and neighboring regions are labeled in Italian. Various places such as 'Bulgaria', 'Serbia', and different strategic sites are identified. Prominently displayed in the foreground is a lighthouse or tower. The lower part of the postcard contains Italian text.
